furniture.name: stasis chamber
furniture.description: A coffin-sized pod of steel and scratched glass, its lid hinged open. The padding inside still holds the shape of whoever slept in it. It's empty.

furniture.name: stasis chamber
furniture.description: Your own: the pod you woke in, its lid still hinged open. A green status light blinks on the rim: the lifepod's emergency cell keeps a charging port alive inside. Leave a power cell, or something with one in it, and it slowly fills.
